title: Entropy and space complexity of random approximate sets
description: Final version (October 2026), with errata; superseded by the monograph Bernoulli Types: Two-Sided Error in Approximate Membership, Retrieval, and Computation, Chapter 8. The joint entropy of false-positive and false-negative counts in the Bernoulli set model, with an asymptotic expansion, and the space lower bound for approximate membership: the one-sided -log2(epsilon) bound of Carter et al. (1978) and the two-sided bound with false negatives of Pagh and Rodler (2001).
